chunks.text: The cooling unit operates from 5 to 40 degrees Celsius. Keep at least 30 centimeters of clearance around each air intake. Replace the air filter every 6 months.
The controller accepts 100 to 240 volts AC at 50 or 60 hertz. Maximum continuous draw is 8 amperes. Connect protective earth before energizing the unit.
The management interface uses TCP port 8443. Telemetry is sent to the collector over UDP port 5514. The device supports IPv4 and IPv6 addressing.
Administrator accounts require a minimum password length of 14 characters. Multifactor authentication is required for remote administration. Audit records are retained for 365 days.
Configuration backups run every 24 hours. Keep the latest 30 backup copies. A restore drill should be completed every 90 days.
Inspect the cooling fan every 3 months. Tighten chassis fasteners to 4 newton meters. Record each service action in the maintenance log.
The standby battery provides 45 minutes of runtime at full load. Replace the battery every 4 years. The low-battery alarm activates at 20 percent remaining capacity.
Calibrate the pressure sensor annually. The acceptable reference range is 98 to 102 kilopascals. Calibration records must include the instrument serial number.
Store the device between minus 10 and 50 degrees Celsius. Storage humidity must remain below 80 percent without condensation. Keep the unit in its original packaging during long-term storage.
Allow 15 minutes for the initial startup sequence. The status indicator flashes amber while initialization is in progress. A steady green indicator means the device is ready.
Maintain 1 meter of unobstructed clearance in front of the emergency shutoff. Use a carbon dioxide extinguisher for energized electrical equipment. Evacuate the room if smoke is detected.
The cooling loop requires 2 liters per minute of water flow. Inlet water temperature must be between 10 and 25 degrees Celsius. A leak sensor is installed beneath the rear manifold.
Firmware version 3.2 adds signed update packages. Version 3.2 also fixes a clock synchronization defect. The previous supported release is version 3.0.

Operators must complete a 2-hour safety orientation before using the equipment. The daily inspection checklist is signed at the start of each shift. Only certified technicians may open the service panel.
The standard warranty lasts 2 years from the shipment date. Warranty claims require the equipment serial number and proof of purchase. Consumable filters are excluded from warranty coverage.
Sound pressure is 52 decibels measured at 1 meter. The acoustic rating applies during normal operation. The unit has no audible alarm when operating in standby mode.
Transport the unit upright and secure it with two straps. Do not stack more than 3 packaged units. The shipping carton weighs 18 kilograms including accessories.
Return used batteries to an approved recycling center. Remove all stored credentials before equipment disposal. The metal chassis is recyclable as mixed steel.
If the status light flashes red, check the inlet temperature and restart the controller once. A repeated red flash requires service support. Record the displayed fault code before contacting support.
